text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It is an unruly machine after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, please do not fret over it.
I shall simply consider that it wasn't meant to be this time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. That "just one more time" tends to accumulate,
breeding complacency and throwing off your entire schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Even so...
I appreciate that you tried your best to win me a plushie, Trainer."
It ended in a disappointing result...
